label: Witches & warlocks
blurb: Covens, hedge witches and pact-bound warlocks: potion brewers, curse breakers and fortune tellers in a candlelit village where magic is a trade like any other.
context: witchcraft and folk magic character with an air of old magic
hobbies: pressing wildflowers between the pages of old books
reading tea leaves for anyone who sits still long enough
brewing new teas from whatever grows by the path
copying spells out of crumbling books
tending a garden of poisonous flowers
baking bread shaped like little animals
sketching the familiars of the village
collecting jars of rainwater from every storm
writing letters that are never sent
quirks: talking to {poss} cat as if it might answer back
never stepping on a crack in the flagstones
knocking three times before entering any room
keeping a sprig of rosemary behind one ear
sniffing every potion before trusting it
leaving a saucer of milk out for whatever comes
goals: earning a seat on the coven council
breaking the curse laid on {poss} family
finding a grimoire lost for a hundred years
brewing a potion no one has ever managed
paying off the debt of an old pact
proving {subj} can do magic without a familiar
finding the witch who taught {poss} mother
learning to speak with the dead properly
keeping the village safe from the witch hunters
flying a broom across the sea
being forgiven for one very bad hex
peeves: a borrowed spellbook returned with a bent spine
a broom that pulls to the left
accessories: a tall pointed hat with a crooked tip
a black cat familiar perched on one shoulder
a raven familiar on one shoulder
a small toad familiar peeking out of a pocket
a crystal pendant on a silver chain
a string of bone and bead charms
a leather-bound grimoire held under one arm
a gnarled wooden wand tucked behind the ear
a pouch of dried herbs at the belt
a small glass vial of glowing liquid on a cord
a moonstone ring on every finger
a crooked walking staff topped with a crystal
a wide-brimmed hat decorated with dried flowers
a broom slung across the back

a dark waistcoat over a loose shirt, a long coat, trousers and buckled boots
